name: Gamepad
author: RussoDaFederal
description:
This plugin adds gamepad support. The analog sticks work on the menus as well. You can change the deadzone and there are event triggers to enable you to set up the hero object movement. For more information, visit https://w3c.github.io/gamepad/

How to use: on the details tab, define the ID of the variable that will hold the deadzone value, as well as the IDs of the events that will trigger upon detecting left and right analog stick movement. Then, set up event triggers for the analog sticks. The events are sent with parameters [id, x, y]. Set all parameters to "anything". id is the ID of the controller, from 1 to 4, sorted by which was connected first. x and y range from -1 to 1: x = -1 is left; x = 1 is right; y = -1 is up; y = 1 is down. You'll get decimal values most of the time.

Tip: you can't set up gamepad buttons on the engine, but you can do so in-game in the title settings menu.

defaultParameters.name: Deadzone variable ID
defaultParameters.description: The deadzone changes according to the value stored in the variable of given ID (must be between 0 and 1)

defaultParameters.name: Left stick event ID
defaultParameters.description: ID of the event that triggers when left analog stick moves

defaultParameters.name: Right stick event ID
defaultParameters.description: ID of the event that triggers when right analog stick moves

parameters.name: Deadzone variable ID
parameters.description: The deadzone changes according to the value stored in the variable of given ID (must be between 0 and 1)

parameters.name: Left stick event ID
parameters.description: ID of the event that triggers when left analog stick moves

parameters.name: Right stick event ID
parameters.description: ID of the event that triggers when right analog stick moves

commands.name: Move 1 step in angle
commands.description: Move object of given ID (-1 is self, 0 is hero) a single step in an angle (in degrees)

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: Map ID of the object to move. -1 is self, 0 is the hero.

defaultParameters.name: dir
defaultParameters.description: Direction to move, in degrees. 0 is east, 90 is north, 180 is west and 270 is south.

defaultParameters.name: withCamera
defaultParameters.description: Wether to move according to camera orientation.

commands.name: Move 1 step in direction
commands.description: Move object of given ID (-1 is self, 0 is hero) a single step in an angle (in degrees)

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: Map ID of the object to move. -1 is self, 0 is the hero.

defaultParameters.name: x
defaultParameters.description: Amount to move in the X axis. Assign the gamepad stick event X parameter to a variable, then assign it to this parameter.

defaultParameters.name: y
defaultParameters.description: Amount to move in the Y axis. Assign the gamepad stick event X parameter to a variable, then assign it to this parameter.

defaultParameters.name: withCamera
defaultParameters.description: Wether to move according to camera orientation.

commands.name: Remove all gamepad assignments
commands.description: CAREFUL! This command will remove all gamepad assignments, rendering your gamepad buttons useless. Be sure to have a Common Reaction ready to reassign default values!

commands.name: Add gamepad assignment
commands.description: Add a single action -> key assignment for the gamepad

defaultParameters.name: actionID
defaultParameters.description: Which engine defined action (i.e. Move left, Action, Cancel) to map to a gamepad key. Must match the NUMERIC ID in the keyboard settings!

defaultParameters.name: key
defaultParameters.description: Which gamepad key to map to a given action (in XBox notation). Valid keys are: A, B, X, Y, LB, RB, LT, RT, Back, Start, L3, R3, Up, Down, Left, Right, Home, L.Axis.Up, L.Axis.Down, L.Axis.Left, L.Axis.Right, R.Axis.Up, R.Axis.Down, R.Axis.Left, R.Axis.Right.

commands.name: Remove ALL custom assignments
commands.description: CAUTION! Returns ALL keyboard and gamepad assignments to default settings (default values can be edited in the engine but not in game).
